Subject: Mutual Planning: Renewal Timeline, Throughput Uplift & QBR booking

Hi Priya / Ben —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. We’re kicking off the mutual plan to cover the upcoming renewal (term refresh) and the throughput uplift you mentioned on Tuesday. I want to align next steps so we can lock in capacity and procurement timing.

Summary / asks:
- Renewal window: target renewal effective date 2026-07-01. Please confirm if that aligns with your fiscal schedule.
- Throughput uplift: you mentioned a steady uplift + a seasonal burst in Q4; we need rough peak RPS and average token growth to size pools.
- Pricing options: we’ll prepare 1) conservative lift (stair-step commit) and 2) burst-enabled (elastic headroom) quotes. Which do you prefer as a baseline?
- QBR: propose a 60-minute renewal QBR the week of 5/24 to review scope, pricing, staffing and procurement (PO vs SOW). Please indicate availability.

Attached: Orchid_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf — initial runbook (milestones + owners).

Next steps from our side: Marissa will draft the pricing scenarios; David will compile SOC2 summary and latency SLs. If you can share the expected uplift numbers (approx tokens / min and peak hours), we’ll size Dedicated pools and present options.

Proposed QBR slots (PST):
- Tue 5/25 10:00–11:00
- Wed 5/26 13:00–14:00
- Thu 5/27 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, send two preferred windows and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Thanks Aisha — this is helpful. A few quick notes: 

- Renewal effective date: 7/1 works for our finance calendar but we need to confirm PO lead times (our procurement needs ~30 days from PO to effective).
- Uplift numbers: current average ~12k tokens/min, expected steady-state 35–40k tokens/min; peak bursts estimated at ~120k tokens/min for 2–3 hours/day during marketing spikes. I’ll confirm with infra but those are the planning numbers.
- For pricing, start with the stair-step commit variant — that will be easier for our CFO to digest. If you can show a transparent cost delta for burst headroom, that would be great.

QBR availability: Wed 5/26 13:00–14:00 PST works best for us. Can you include an agenda and invite engineering (Ben) and procurement? Also we’ll need SOC2 / data residency notes in advance for our security review.

Onward —
Priya
VP, Product & Data
Orchid.ai
